name: Click Before Frames
description: Experimental input-time-shift utility for GD 2.2081. Intercepts the physical input funnel, keeps a bounded simulation snapshot ring, and re-asserts your click N ticks earlier in world time.

enabled.name: Enable Cheat / Mod
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the mod does nothing at all.

tick-count.name: Saved Ticks (Frames)
tick-count.description: How many physics ticks (1 tick = 1/240 s) to shift a press backwards in world time.

rollback-shift.name: Enable Snapshot Rewind (experimental)
rollback-shift.description: The actual tick-shift. Restores a snapshot of the simulation from N ticks ago and re-asserts your input. Off = the mod only measures and reports, and changes nothing.

show-hud.name: Show HUD Indicator
show-hud.description: Displays current mode, shift count and input state on screen during gameplay.

toggle-key.name: Toggle Key
toggle-key.description: Toggles the mod on / off in game (Shift + this key cycles the saved ticks instead).

allow-in-practice.name: Allow in Practice Mode
allow-in-practice.description: Off by default: rewinding while the game's own practice checkpoints are active can fight with them.

max-objects.name: Snapshot Object Budget
max-objects.description: Skip snapshotting on levels with more than this many live objects. Snapshots copy object state every step, so this is the main performance guard.

debug-log.name: Verbose Logging
debug-log.description: Log every captured step, shift and guard rejection to Geode's log.
